note: The one list of versions of the Talos Relay phone page. The page shows it under Version history.

releases.title: Pick the model, and chat with no computer
changes: Below the prompt box you pick the model the next prompt goes to. A chat keeps its model until you pick another one.
New device: This phone (no computer). The phone asks a free model itself, so it answers when the computer is off. It only chats: files and steps need Talos on a computer.
On the phone alone, Glow's free AI needs no key. Under Models and keys you add a free key of OpenRouter, Groq or Cerebras, or get the keys from your computer (on it: `talos relay keys openrouter`).
Chats and keys of the phone alone stay in this browser. A prompt goes straight to the service of its model, not through the relay.

releases.title: Talos Relay without the relay on the internet
changes: The computer can hand out this page itself: on the computer run `talos relay mode local` (or `both`), then `talos relay pair`. A phone on the same Wi-Fi then reaches Talos with no service on the internet.
Over plain http a browser offers no cipher of its own, so the page brings one (lite-crypto.js). What crosses the network is sealed with the same key as before.
When the page comes from the computer itself, a failed request says that the phone must be on the same Wi-Fi.

releases.title: The look and the parts of Vector Relay
changes: The page now has the dark look and the layout of Vector Relay: the chat list at the side, the prompt box at the bottom, one feed per chat.
More than one computer: add a device, pick it at the top of the chat list, rename it.
A 4-digit code links a phone without a camera: on the computer run `talos relay code`.
All chats: every chat of every linked computer on one page, the running ones first, with their last steps. A row can be opened as a chat or removed from the list.
A photo can go along with a prompt. It reaches the model as an attachment, so the model must be one that reads images.
Search in the chat list, a mark on chats with something new, answers shown with headings, lists, code and tables.
A prompt that did not reach the computer stays in the feed with Try again and Remove.
The computer keeps one connection to the relay open, so a request is picked up sooner.
Talos Relay starts at sign-in on macOS and Linux as well as on Windows: `talos relay install`.

releases.title: Talos Relay
changes: See the Talos chats of your computer from anywhere, start a new one, send the next prompt.
Stop a chat that is working, and answer when Talos asks before a step: allow once, always allow, or refuse.
Everything between the computer and the phone is sealed with a key only the two have.
